Render-Path Unification — Wave 5 (2026-07-16): the FINALE — collapse the 5th renderer

Phase: DIGEST. 15 survey reports folded. This wave retires the last of the 5→3 PortableDoc renderers so @barkpark/react is the ONE JS renderer serving web/ and the blog starter, with Elixir + Go as proven parity twins. Two tracks share the canonical renderer: TRACK A (web/ fork retirement — the epic's reason to exist) and TRACK B (blog-starter, the outward flagship).

What the survey established (and how it reframes the wish)

  1. Strategize Discovery 1 was WRONG about which dir. The create-barkpark-app BLOG template is js/packages/create-barkpark-app/templates/blog-starter/ — a FULL Next app (index app/page.tsx, app/posts/[slug]/page.tsx, draft-preview.tsx) that ALREADY renders via the legacy PortableText value-prop export of @barkpark/react (post page L5/L99, draft-preview L4/L85). Schema is content: richText; seed content is already a block() array. The repo-root templates/blog-starter/ (data-only manifest, body:text plain-string) that Discovery 1 described is a DIFFERENT catalog (deploy-button/Go bootstrap) and is NOT the scaffold source. Track B is MIGRATE-EXISTING (PortableText→PortableDoc + /client), not build-fresh. Confirmed by 3 independent surveyors.
  2. W4 /client IS on origin/main. #3604 + #3605 merged 2026-07-16; git cat-file -e origin/main:js/packages/react/src/client.ts = EXISTS; package.json exports carry ./client. Local checkout is 11 commits behind — cut worktrees from origin/main, never local HEAD. The Strategize "not yet landed" note is STALE.
  3. "3 media families hydrate" is inaccurate. hydratePortableDoc(root) hydrates ONLY TWO — mermaid (pre.mermaid) and asciicast (div.bp-asciicast[data-cast-src]). IMAGE is static SSR (bare <img>); its "parity" is preset→rendition resolution in BarkparkImage/imageUrl, no hydration. mermaid is the diagram block type (fixture diagram.golden.json, not "mermaid").
  4. "re-point component-projections onto canonical" is a category error. web/lib/component-projections.ts is a pure-TS PRE-RENDER projector, not a renderer; canonical reimplements its coercions internally and never imports it. It KEEPS 2 live consumers after the fork dies (task-board-columns.ts, component-golden-parity.test.ts) — deleting it breaks the parity spine; re-pointing it is meaningless. Decide call: KEEP-as-island (cheapest) vs RETIRE — NOT forced by the fork deletion.
  5. The 3 named web tests are mostly NOT renderer-coupled. valueref.test.ts imports lib/papers.ts helpers, never the fork — survives untouched. component-golden-parity.test.ts has a projector-deepEqual leg (survives) + a RENDER leg importing renderBlock asserting Tailwind classes (must re-author or retire). section-grid-render.test.ts is the SOLE real re-point (imports renderBlock). "Reuse pd-golden fixtures + dom-shape comparator as-is" mis-describes these — those fixtures/comparator live in js/packages/react/tests/ and drive a SEPARATE proof (PortableDoc.parity.test.tsx), unreachable from web (different runner, not in published files).
  6. Canonical PortableDoc is an HTML-STRING emitter (dangerouslySetInnerHTML, prop value not blocks) with NO per-block renderBlock export and NO editor/PaperEditor export. So test re-points are RE-AUTHORS not swaps, and PaperEditorDoc has no canonical home.
  7. PaperEditorDoc is dead-by-default. NEXT_PUBLIC_PAPER_EDITOR is set NOWHERE in web/ — the "read"-mode branch never executes. Low-risk option: DROP the branch; else re-home as a thin web-local wrapper over paper-editor-mount.tsx (which is fork-independent and survives).
  8. web/ is a standalone pnpm project (own lockfile; root workspace lists only web + js/packages/core; never references @barkpark/react). Three integration options: (a) file: workspace dep mirroring @barkpark/core; (b) published npm — NON-STARTER (published preview.1 predates PortableDoc, lacks /client); (c) vendored tgz (file:./vendor/barkpark-react.tgz) — what the sibling search-starters already use. A nested web/pnpm-workspace.yaml is a known CI-breaker.
  9. Ledger: epic portabledoc-blog-epic-goal has 18 children, NONE an rpu-w5-* slice — both W5 tracks are UNFILED (Decide files fresh). The 4 backlog candidates are ALL already filed; W5 CONSUMES/CLAIMS them (esp. rpu-backlog-live-block-hydration = the W4 prereq, toplaintext-typekeyed = index excerpts, composed-doc-parity + hydration-consuming-app-docs map onto Track B). Do NOT re-file.

Contradictions / tensions for Decide

  • website-starter is an equal legacy PortableText consumer (the DEFAULT scaffold template, 3 pages) but is DO-NOT-TOUCH this wave (foreign session owns the template tree). Migrating only blog-starter leaves the epic's "one renderer serves starters" claim false for the default template — file as backlog, do not silently expand scope.
  • Seed storage is unresolved: the scaffold's content: richText already holds a block array, but there is NO native block-array field type in schema-v2 (composite/arrayOf/codelist/localizedText only). Whether the API round-trips a Block[] in a richText field, or the Next data layer must parse it, is a real integration decision (Track B).
  • Delete vs half-delete: a fork deletion that strands an importer breaks the web build. The importer census must be exact on origin/main before the delete.

Coverage map — checked/found, checked/NOT-found, and unreached corners

Checked & FOUND (evidence solid, no re-verify needed)

  • Scaffold blog template pages + PortableText import sites (page.tsx:5/99, draft-preview.tsx:4/85); schema content:richText; seed block() array.
  • @barkpark/react exports both legacy PortableText and canonical PortableDoc+renderPortableDocument; 42-type registry CI-asserted (PortableDoc.test.tsx:313 toHaveLength(42)).
  • W4 ./client + hydratePortableDoc ON origin/main (#3604/#3605 merged); selectors + idempotency stamps + lazy external imports.
  • Fork exports = 3 (renderBlock, PortableDoc, PaperEditorDoc); importers = exactly 3 files (document-detail + 2 tests), identical on origin/main.
  • component-projections role (projector not renderer); its 2 surviving consumers; valueref = web server pre-render step.
  • web/ standalone workspace seam; core is the dual-member precedent; nested-workspace CI hazard.
  • Gates: ci.yml web-checks (Node 22, blocking), js-tests.yml (Node 20 + changesets), lighthouse/Vercel advisory, elixir.yml triggers-but-shouldn't-block.

Checked & NOT FOUND (absences = decisions-in-waiting)

  • No Sanity/@portabletext dependency anywhere in the scaffold (the "legacy" is naming/conventions only, same canonical package).
  • No canonical editor/PaperEditor export; no per-block renderBlock export — only whole-doc HTML-string API.
  • No top-level timeline block type (only roadmap / task-detail sub-field) — diff before assuming web needs one.
  • No rpu-w5-* task in the ledger; no fork-deletion task; no PaperEditorDoc-home task.
  • No open PR touches any blog-starter root (collision-clear as of survey).
  • No CSP notes in client.ts or the media-parity test — strict-CSP behavior of mermaid@11 in a consuming Next app is UNPROVEN.
  • No starter uses hydratePortableDoc yet — the /client island wiring is genuinely build-fresh (no prior art).

Corners NO surveyor reached

  • Branch-protection required-status-checks config (which checks actually block a web/+js-only PR) — inferred from memory, not queried.
  • The create-barkpark-app data layer (lib/barkpark.ts/lib/queries.ts) content mapping — whether the API document envelope delivers Block[] or a stringified body to the post page.
  • Whether next build resolves the ./client subpath's dynamic external imports (mermaid, asciinema-player) — must the starter declare them?
  • bp FTS on papers/tasks — no surveyor had a working search verb; a prior-art W5 slice under a different naming scheme could exist (low probability; ledger-scan covered epic children).

Verify plan — 8 assignments in flight (this round closes unknowns before Decide)

Load-bearing claims are PROVEN by RUN output, not reading. All worktrees cut from origin/main (local is 11 behind). All builders will be opus; verifiers mixed per below.

  1. [canonical-render-hydrate-proof] (opus, worktree). RUN the react package build + PortableDoc.parity.test.tsx (42-type shape parity) + @barkpark/media-parity Playwright browser test. Proves canonical renders all 42 + mermaid→svg & asciicast→.ap-player actually hydrate. The whole epic rests on this.
  2. [web-baseline-and-importer-census] (sonnet, worktree). RUN web's full gate (test+typecheck+lint) GREEN on origin/main as the pre-change baseline; produce the exhaustive git-grep importer census of portable-doc.tsx (incl. tsx-loader.mjs stub coupling). Distrust-vacuous-green baseline + safe-delete map.
  3. [web-react-integration-probe] (opus, worktree). PROBE the file: workspace wiring: add js/packages/react to ROOT pnpm-workspace.yaml + file: dep in web, build react, pnpm install, import PortableDoc + /client in a web component, typecheck. Proves web resolves canonical WITHOUT the nested-workspace CI-breaker; compares against the vendored-tgz route.
  4. [section-grid-reauthor-cost] (opus, worktree). RUN canonical renderPortableDocument([section]) vs the section-grid-render.test.ts assertions; prove which hold (bp-section__grid, --bp-tracks, span) and which fail (inline grid-template repeat() + 720px MQ moved to paper-surface.css). Sizes the only real test re-point.
  5. [paper-editor-flag-and-home] (sonnet). git-grep prove NEXT_PUBLIC_PAPER_EDITOR is unset repo-wide (dead branch → DROP viable) and that paper-editor-mount.tsx is fork-independent (survives a web-local wrapper). Settles drop-vs-wrap.
  6. [seed-schema-storage-proof] (opus, worktree). PROVE the scaffold's richText content shape feeds canonical PortableDoc directly (render a concatenated pd-golden 42-block Block[] → 0 unknown blocks, 42 distinct classes) and trace the create-barkpark-app data layer to determine whether the seed body persists/reads as Block[] or a stringified field. Settles the Track-B storage decision.
  7. [blog-starter-build-and-collision] (sonnet, worktree). Establish the scaffold blog template's build/typecheck baseline (does it compile on PortableText today?) and RE-SCAN open PRs on origin/main for any concurrent blog-starter edit (foreign session owns the tree). Confirms Track B starts clean.
  8. [required-checks-and-elixir-gate] (sonnet). Query branch-protection required checks + a recent merged web/js-only PR's statusCheckRollup to PROVE the api Elixir gate does not block this scope and which checks DO. Confirms the merge path.

Out of scope this wave (filed/flagged, not built): website-starter migration (foreign-owned default template); field-*/embed golden coverage (no schema-doc surface here); role-ladder drift guard (no task-board grammar in a blog).

DECIDE (2026-07-16): ground truth, decisions, and the 2-slice wave

Phase: DECIDE. Two rounds of ground truth in hand. The load-bearing correction: the verify round's "blog-starter is data-only / build-fresh" examined the WRONG directory. Decisions below follow the evidence where it contradicts the direction.

Verification results (what the Decide round re-proved on origin/main)

  • W4 /client is LANDED (direction was stale). git cat-file -e origin/main:js/packages/react/src/client.ts → EXISTS; origin/main:js/packages/react/package.json exports "./client"; client.ts exports hydratePortableDoc. Local checkout was 20 commits behind — builders cut worktrees from origin/main. No need to build on the pattern.
  • Track-B target CORRECTED — it is the create-barkpark-app SCAFFOLD app, not the repo-root manifest. git ls-tree origin/main -- js/packages/create-barkpark-app/templates/blog-starter = a full Next app (page.tsx, posts/[slug]/page.tsx, draft-preview.tsx, seeds/seed.ts, schemas/post.ts). Post page: import { PortableText } from '@barkpark/react' + <PortableText value={post.content} />; schema content: richText; seed content: [block('...')] (Sanity _type:'block'). So Track B is MIGRATE-EXISTING (PortableText→PortableDoc + wire /client), NOT build-fresh. The verify round's data-only finding was the repo-root templates/blog-starter/ — a different, deploy-button manifest.
  • web/ fork still live, exactly 3 importers. git grep -nE "components/portable-doc" origin/main -- 'web/*' → document-detail.tsx:10 (PortableDoc + PaperEditorDoc), component-golden-parity.test.ts:266 + section-grid-render.test.ts:33 (renderBlock). Canonical exports neither renderBlock nor an editor doc — so "re-point" is a render-seam re-author, and PaperEditorDoc needs a web-local home.
  • Workspace seam confirmed. root pnpm-workspace.yaml = ['web','js/packages/core'] (react NOT a member); web/package.json has @barkpark/core file:../js/packages/core + @barkpark/nextjs 1.0.0-preview.3, no react. ci.yml web-checks builds core before web install — the react build step must be cloned. Nested web workspace file is the known CI-killer.
  • Track-B proof home found. create-barkpark-app is a workspace member (not private, version 1.0.0-preview.0) with test: vitest run + tests/scaffold-pure.test.ts. It is a co-member of react in the js/ workspace — the one place Track B can render the seed through @barkpark/react and PROVE 42-type coverage without a copied-out next build. 42 pd-golden fixtures confirmed present. Sync script scripts/sync-starter-templates.mjs parses (node --check OK).

Decisions (each mirrors a charter D-line)

  • D22 — Track B = the create-barkpark-app scaffold app, migrate-existing off PortableText+richText. Why: the wish's "create-barkpark-app BLOG template" is the full Next app, not the data-only manifest the verify round saw.
  • D23 — Track A seam = file: dep, ROOT-workspace-only, + a react dist-build step in ci.yml. Why: published preview.1 predates PortableDoc/·/client; the file: build is the only source; the ci.yml step is load-bearing or web reds on missing dist; a nested workspace file took CI down once.
  • D24 — PaperEditorDoc re-homed web-local, not dropped. Why: the read-mode editor is a deliberate (flag-dead-by-default) capability; strand it and a wired feature vanishes silently.
  • D25 — document-detail is a prop rename (blocks→value); the 2 render-leg tests are a RE-AUTHOR onto renderPortableDocument([block]) asserting bp-*, adding NO new public export. Why: canonical is a string-HTML whole-doc emitter with a minimal surface (D2); the wish under-stated this as an import swap.
  • D26 — valueref.test.ts, component-projections.ts, and the projector leg of golden-parity STAY untouched. Why: proven renderer-independent; the wish's "update all 3 tests" over-scoped.
  • D27 — delete portable-doc.tsx LAST, one atomic slice, gated on zero-importer grep. Why: the gate runs every test file; a half-delete breaks the build.
  • D28 — Track-B seed = 42 pd-golden .input concatenated into a plain-data Block[] module, proven in create-barkpark-app vitest. Why: reuse pd-golden as-is; the composed render also satisfies the intent of rpu-backlog-composed-doc-parity, provable locally without a publish.
  • D29 — ship-to-users via a published react (human-gated follow); bump the pin + add mermaid/asciinema deps; sync the cloud mirror + changeset. Why: the template is copied out and installs published npm.

Wave plan (2 slices, both Opus — Fable exhausted; file-disjoint → parallel)

  • rpu-w5-web-fork-retire (TRACK A, large, Opus). Surface: web/ + root workspace + ci.yml. Files: pnpm-workspace.yaml, web/package.json, .github/workflows/ci.yml, web/components/document-detail.tsx, web/components/paper-editor-doc.tsx (new), web/components/portable-doc.tsx (DELETE), web/__tests__/section-grid-render.test.ts, web/__tests__/component-golden-parity.test.ts, web/__tests__/support/tsx-loader.mjs. Gate: cd js && pnpm --filter @barkpark/react build; cd web && pnpm install && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run lint + empty git grep components/portable-doc web.
  • rpu-w5-blog-starter-migrate (TRACK B, large, Opus). Surface: create-barkpark-app scaffold + cloud mirror. Files: js/packages/create-barkpark-app/templates/blog-starter/, js/packages/create-barkpark-app/package.json, js/packages/create-barkpark-app/tests/, cloud/priv/templates/blog-starter/, js/.changeset/. Gate: pnpm --filter create-barkpark-app test && pnpm --filter create-barkpark-app typecheck + diff -r mirror-clean.

Composed-doc parity is folded into Track B's proof (one composed 42-type render); the stricter Elixir-golden comparison stays backlog (needs an api generator, out of scope).

Backlog filed this wave (published epic children)

  • rpu-backlog-publish-react-canonical (p2, human-gated) — publish @barkpark/react carrying PortableDoc+/client; the scaffolded app is broken for real users until it lands.
  • rpu-backlog-website-starter-migrate (p3, foreign-owned) — the DEFAULT scaffold template consumes the same legacy PortableText in 3 pages; out of this wave's blog-only scope.

Pre-existing epic children NOT re-filed (verified open): rpu-backlog-composed-doc-parity, rpu-backlog-hydration-consuming-app-docs, rpu-backlog-toplaintext-typekeyed, rpu-backlog-field-embed-coverage, rpu-backlog-asciicast-full-render-proof.

DEBRIEF (Phase: REVIEW, 2026-07-16) — the FINALE landed: one JS renderer

Verdict: both slices green on their reviewer -r branches; wave grade A−. The epic's stated finale is complete — after these two branches merge, @barkpark/react is the ONE canonical JS PortableDoc renderer serving web/ AND the create-barkpark-app blog starter, with Elixir (:article) and Go/pdrender as the proven parity twins. The 5th renderer (web/components/portable-doc.tsx, 1435 lines) is deleted.

Per slice

  • rpu-w5-web-fork-retire (TRACK A) — final branch loop-epic/retire-the-web-portabledoc-fork-onto-can-0-r. Retired the web fork onto canonical @barkpark/react via a root-workspace file: dep + a ci.yml react-build step (D23), re-pointed document-detail.tsx (blocks→value, D25), re-homed PaperEditorDoc web-local over the surviving paper-editor-mount.tsx (D24), re-authored the section-grid-render + component-golden-parity render legs onto renderPortableDocument([block]) asserting bp-* markup (D25, leaving valueref/projections/the projector-deepEqual leg untouched per D26), and DELETED the fork (D27). Reviewer fix (load-bearing): the builder's zero-importer gate ! git grep -nE 'components/portable-doc' -- web/ was NOT empty at commit — a doc comment in the new paper-editor-doc.tsx quoted web/components/portable-doc.tsx verbatim, matching the pattern, so the gate the builder claimed green actually reds. Reworded the comment; grep now truly empty. Full gate re-run on -r: @barkpark/react build 0, web typecheck 0, node --test 258 pass / 0 fail / 0 skipped, lint 0, grep empty.
  • rpu-w5-blog-starter-migrate (TRACK B) — final branch loop-epic/migrate-the-create-barkpark-app-blog-sca-1-r (no reviewer code changes needed). Migrated the scaffold post page + draft-preview off the legacy PortableText onto a 'use client' PortableDocSurface island that SSR-renders renderPortableDocument(blocks) inside .bp-paper-surface and hydrates the media mounts via hydratePortableDoc from @barkpark/react/client (mermaid + asciicast; image stays static, D22/D29). Seeded the full 42-type grammar as an AUTO-GENERATED showcase-content.ts (a gen-showcase-content.mjs concatenates the 42 pd-golden .input objects — one source of truth, idempotent: reviewer re-ran it, zero drift), proven by a non-vacuous vitest that renders all 42 types and fingerprints 42 DISTINCT renderings + the 3 media mount points (D28). Bumped the react pin to ^1.0.0-preview.2, added mermaid/asciinema deps + a changeset (D29), synced the cloud mirror (diff -r clean). Gate re-run on -r: create-barkpark-app 21 pass, typecheck 0, mirror diff -r exit 0.

Grade A− — what earns it

Strong: the wave delivers exactly the wish's finale — the 5th renderer is gone, both consumer surfaces run on the canonical renderer, and the deletion is proven safe (zero importers, tests green ON the canonical renderer, not a stubbed fork). The tests are genuinely non-vacuous: Track A's re-authored legs assert the REAL built @barkpark/react bp-* output (258 assertions), Track B renders every one of the 42 seeded blocks through the real renderer and proves 42 distinct fingerprints. One-source-of-truth discipline throughout (generator over the frozen goldens, not a hand-authored array; script-synced cloud mirror). Both slices file-disjoint and cohere.

What docks it from A: Track A's builder stamped criterion 3 (“git grep … empty”) and its self-review claimed “final grep empty” while the gate in fact redded on a comment false-positive — a small but real false-green claim in a load-bearing deletion proof, fixed here in one line. Not structural; the shipped -r state is correct. Deferred-but-flagged: the @barkpark/react npm publish carrying PortableDoc+/client is a human-gated backlog item (rpu-backlog-publish-react-canonical) — a scaffolded blog is broken for real end-users until it lands (the local D28 vitest proves correctness, it does not close the user path). Minor honest-state delta: the canonical renderer shows an empty .bp-paper-surface for an empty paper where the fork printed an italic “no content” (the editor path keeps the message) — acceptable under content-first doctrine.

Ledger audit

Both slice tasks are children of portabledoc-blog-epic-goal and carry wave_paper. Both left lifecycle in_progress with criteria stamped-with-evidence and the merge-gated criterion (PR merged) OPEN for the lead — honest. Track A's criterion-3 evidence (“grep empty”) was optimistic at commit but is now TRUE on the merged -r state; left as-is (no reopen needed). No out-of-wave tasks were touched. Backlog children verified present. No ledger mutations required.

What the lead must close on merge

  • Merge loop-epic/retire-the-web-portabledoc-fork-onto-can-0-r (NOT the original — it carries the grep-gate fix) and loop-epic/migrate-the-create-barkpark-app-blog-sca-1-r. Track A touches web/JS + ci.yml; Track B is JS + cloud-mirror only — neither waits on the Elixir Test gate. File-disjoint → either order.
  • On merge, flip rpu-w5-web-fork-retire criterion 5 and rpu-w5-blog-starter-migrate criterion 6 (both “PR merged”) and close both tasks done.

Next wave

The render-path-unification epic's build work is DONE with this finale. The one remaining user-facing gap is the human-gated rpu-backlog-publish-react-canonical npm publish — once @barkpark/react@1.0.0-preview.2 (carrying PortableDoc+/client) is on npm, scaffolded blogs render for real. Secondary backlog, all lower priority: website-starter migration (foreign-owned default template), the stricter Elixir-golden composed-doc DOM comparison (needs an api composed-golden generator), a real .cast asciicast sample, and the field-*/embed coverage deferred by D7. None block declaring the epic goal met once the two branches merge and the publish lands.
